findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_intent · Private data: list_outposts, get_outpost_door_state, register_intent, poll_notify · Public sink: register_intent, poll_notify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_intent · Private data: list_outposts, get_outpost_door_state, register_intent, poll_notify · Public sink: register_intent, poll_notify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
